summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a routine London Stock Exchange admission-to-trading notification under the UK Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024 (POATRs) PRM 1.6.4R, the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer. The notice covers 16,274 new ordinary shares of USD 0.20 each, ISIN GB0009223206, issued under employee share schemes between 11 August and 7 September 2026 and admitted from 18 September 2026, fully fungible with existing shares. Total issued capital is 877,750,024 ordinary shares, of which 40,317,488 are held in treasury. No special-situation event, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the share issuance is immaterial to capital structure and presents no risk-arb angle.
